title: Characteristic polynomial of a finite free module: basis independence, isomorphism invariance, monic of degree n, base change
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $n\ge0$, $N$ a free $R$-module of rank $n$ (with a basis of $n$ elements) and $\psi:N\to N$ an $R$-linear map; for a basis $e$ of $N$ let $\chi_e\in R[T]$ be the characteristic polynomial of $\psi$ in the basis $e$ [def-weil-pbc-charpoly-free-module]. (a) $\chi_e$ does not depend on the basis $e$ (of $n$ elements); write $\chi_\psi$. (b) If $N'$ is an $R$-module, $u:N\to N'$ an $R$-linear isomorphism and $\psi'=u\psi u^{-1}$, then $N'$ is free of rank $n$ and $\chi_{\psi'}=\chi_\psi$. (c) $\chi_\psi=T^n+c_{n-1}T^{n-1}+\dots+c_0$ with $c_k\in R$, i.e. its coefficient of $T^n$ is $1$ and those of $T^k$, $k>n$, are $0$. (d) For a ring map $\rho:R\to R'$, the base change $N\otimes_RR'$ [def-weil-module-base-change] is a free $R'$-module of rank $n$ with basis $e_1\otimes1,\dots,e_n\otimes1$, the matrix of $\psi\otimes1$ in it is $\rho(X)$ (entrywise), and $\chi_{\psi\otimes1}=\rho(\chi_\psi)$ (coefficientwise image in $R'[T]$).
